allow: PowerShell($os = Get-CimInstance Win32_OperatingSystem; $cpu = Get-CimInstance Win32_Processor | Select-Object -First 1; "FreeRAM_GB={0:N1} of {1:N1}" -f \($os.FreePhysicalMemory/1MB\), \($os.TotalVisibleMemorySize/1MB\); "CPU_Load%=$\($cpu.LoadPercentage\)")

PowerShell($os = Get-CimInstance Win32_OperatingSystem; "FreeRAM_GB={0:N1}/{1:N1}" -f \($os.FreePhysicalMemory/1MB\),\($os.TotalVisibleMemorySize/1MB\); try { $c=\(Get-CimInstance Win32_Processor | Measure-Object -Property LoadPercentage -Average\).Average; "CPU_avg%=$c" } catch { "CPU n/a" })

PowerShell($os = Get-CimInstance Win32_OperatingSystem; "FreeRAM_GB={0:N1}/{1:N1}" -f \($os.FreePhysicalMemory/1MB\),\($os.TotalVisibleMemorySize/1MB\); try { $c=\(Get-CimInstance Win32_Processor | Measure-Object -Property LoadPercentage -Average\).Average; "CPU%=$c" } catch {})

PowerShell($os = Get-CimInstance Win32_OperatingSystem; "$\([math]::Round\($os.FreePhysicalMemory/1024\)\) MB free / $\([math]::Round\($os.TotalVisibleMemorySize/1024\)\) MB total"; "CPU load: $\(\(Get-CimInstance Win32_Processor\).LoadPercentage\)%")

PowerShell($os = Get-CimInstance Win32_OperatingSystem; "$\([math]::Round\($os.FreePhysicalMemory/1024\)\) MB free"; "CPU: $\(\(Get-CimInstance Win32_Processor | Measure-Object -Property LoadPercentage -Average\).Average\)%")
